title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: Event group chat for organisers and presenters in webinars and structured meetings
notes: claim 49: severity blocker on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents event group chat on the room console and a view-only restriction for rooms joining as presenters, but the briefing reports those details as unstated. The cost and risk rationales also conflict with the briefing's own description of licence purchases and newly accessible backstage messages.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The supplied feature descriptions describe a chat experience rather than an agent or automated action.
claims.quote: you have access to the private chat for event management known as the Event Group. You can also switch to a separate chat with attendees

claims.claim: Meeting chat is configured in Teams admin center at Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Meeting engagement > Meeting chat.
claims.quote:
go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
Select the policy you want to edit.
Go to the Meeting engagement section.
Set Meeting chat to your chosen value

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -MeetingChatEnabledType Disabled turns off meeting chat.
claims.quote:
To turn off meeting chat for users with this assigned policy, run the following command:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -MeetingChatEnabledType Disabled
claims.fix: The cited guide prints this command, but https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/microsoftteams/set-csteamsmeetingpolicy?view=teams-ps says setting MeetingChatEnabledType to Disabled also requires LobbyChat Disabled. Replace the call in both places with 'Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -MeetingChatEnabledType Disabled -LobbyChat Disabled', use that reference as api.docs, and cite it.

claims.claim: Meeting chat is a per-user and per-organizer policy.
claims.quote: This setting doesn't apply to channel meetings and is a per-user and per-organizer policy.

claims.claim: The Meeting chat policy does not apply to channel meetings.
claims.quote: This setting doesn't apply to channel meetings

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No feature-specific separate price, meter or cap is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Android event group chat webinars structured meetings price meter limits. Read Rooms licensing, release notes, Manage meeting chat, Manage event chat and the notice; found no separate price, meter or cap for this feature.

claims.claim: The cited pages do not give the Teams Rooms Pro licence price.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Android event group chat webinars structured meetings price meter limits. Read cited licensing, release-note, chat, planning and troubleshooting pages; none states a Teams Rooms Pro licence price.

claims.claim: Attendees, administrators and all other users see no change.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Teams Rooms on Android' 'chat' '574107' attendees. Read roadmap, notice, Rooms release notes and Host or attend an event from an MTR. They name intended room users but do not state that every other user's experience is unchanged.
claims.fix: Remove 'Attendees and other users see no change' from Scope and 'attendees and admins see no change' from the impact rationale. Retain the positively documented room-user scope.

claims.claim: The risk rationale says no new data access is described, while the body describes new room access to backstage messages.
claims.quote: rationale: 'no new data access or agent behaviour is described'; Why it matters: 'it puts a backstage channel on a shared room device, and the people who read it are whoever is in the room.'
claims.fix: Remove 'new data access or' from the risk rationale. The remaining statement about no agent behaviour being described does not deny the newly available backstage-chat access.

claims.claim: The cost rating is low even though its rationale identifies purchasing Teams Rooms Pro licences as the deciding cost.
claims.quote: cost: 'low'; rationale: 'the cost is the Teams Rooms Pro licence on any Android room that lacks one.' The scale defines low as 'indirect cost only: admin time, communications, training.'
claims.fix: Keep cost low only by replacing its rationale with 'Low. The feature is included for Teams Rooms Pro-licensed Android rooms; the expected indirect cost is admin time to brief organisers and room users.' This rates the change for its documented Pro-room audience rather than treating licence purchases as indirect cost.
